1.explanation: In the code above we enable search boxes by setting showSearch to true and pass a single searchProps object. Because Transfer currently applies the same searchProps to left and right internally, both panels render a search box with identical behavior. There is currently no prop like searchProps.left or searchProps.right to selectively disable or customize one side, which leads to the bug scenario: the right panel’s search box cannot be turned off independently.
1.bug_scenario: When using the Transfer component with showSearch and passing a single searchProps object, the same search box configuration is applied to both the left and right panels. There is no built-in way to disable or reconfigure one side independently – the right panel’s search box always appears even if you only want it on the left.
